result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Customer may assign without consent to an affiliate or qualifying successor, IBM requires Customer consent that may not be unreasonably withheld and may never assign to a Customer competitor, and IBM receives no change-of-control termination right. The edits are targeted and retain the original liability and invalid-assignment provisions. Drafting is clear, although the margin comment inaccurately characterizes the preferred position as requiring “symmetry,” when it is intentionally asymmetric.
